args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

1. Swimwear
2. Sunscreen
3. Hat
4. Sunglasses
5. Light clothing (t-shirts, shorts)
6. Quick-dry clothes
7. Flip-flops or sandals
8. Camera or phone with charger
9. Snacks and water
10. Travel documents (passport, tickets)
11. First-aid kit
12. Insect repellent
13. Umbrella or raincoat (for unexpected showers)
14. Beach towel
15. Personal toiletries

Note: Pack light and be mindful of Hawaii's tropical climate.
